title: PASS-AUDIT slice 6 - UI-FP 101-197 unaudited PASS rows (<=30 rows)

summary.scope: UI-FP PASS rows 101-197, batch 6 of unaudited PASS rows
summary.method: Per-row read of evidence_ref + tested_commit on cert branch; KEEP vs DEMOTE against execution_proof and independent_oracle
